description: Shivesh Shandilaya and Shahrzad Roshankhah published numerical simulations of fluid injection into fractured rock representative of the Utah FORGE enhanced geothermal system. The dataset contains Irazú finite-discrete-element configurations, input parameters and hydromechanical response results. Its coverage is limited to a homogeneous medium and three field-derived fracture networks under common stress and injection conditions. Outputs include wellbore pressure, fracture growth, stress evolution and tensile or shear joint failure. The authors identify reuse for reproducing their results, benchmarking coupled models and testing sensitivity to fracture geometry and injection conditions. DesignSafe provides public repository access at no stated charge under Creative Commons Attribution, with an unspecified licence version. File formats and software requirements need further checking; no models were executed. These are simulation results, not measured reservoir performance. The related DesignSafe Data Depot record describes the repository.
